The ad shows a roomy two-person cabin ready for daily use.
checked_claims.fact: The Peak Fuji is a two-person cabin built from Canadian red cedar, inside and out.

checked_claims.ad_said: The ad implies the heat reaches the whole body, not just one spot.
checked_claims.fact: Heat comes from full-spectrum infrared panels placed around the cabin, covering near, mid, and far wavelengths up to 150°F.

checked_claims.ad_said: The ad doesn't mention what outlet this plugs into at home.
checked_claims.fact: The Fuji runs on a dedicated 120V / 20A outlet.

checked_claims.ad_said: The ad doesn't say how it ships or sets up.
checked_claims.fact: Shipping is free, with in-stock orders handled in two to four business days before transit; assembly uses a clasp-together design.

checked_claims.ad_said: The ad doesn't mention sound or extras built into the cabin.
checked_claims.fact: The Fuji includes two Bluetooth speakers for audio during a session.

questions.question: What outlet does the Fuji need?
questions.answer: It runs on a dedicated 120V / 20A outlet. Check this against your room before ordering.

questions.question: How is the Fuji delivered and assembled?
questions.answer: Shipping is free. In-stock orders take two to four business days to process, then three to seven in transit, and the cabin goes together with a clasp-together assembly.

questions.question: What's covered under warranty?
questions.answer: 7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

questions.question: How hot does the Fuji get?
questions.answer: The cabin heats up to 150°F using full-spectrum infrared across near, mid, and far wavelengths.

questions.question: Can I return it if it doesn't fit my space?
questions.answer: Returns require the sauna disassembled and repacked in its original crate, with a restocking fee and return shipping paid by the customer.

closing.headline: Save on the Fuji while the sale lasts
